subject: Municipal Parking Enforcement and Hospital Merger Support
overview: The Council addressed persistent complaints regarding the new municipal parking program, including enforcement errors and kiosk malfunction. Members also voted to support the proposed merger of Lawrence Memorial Hospital with Partners Healthcare and called for a reversal of janitorial staff cuts at Tufts University.

items.title: Public Participation on Municipal Parking Program
items.summary: Resident Elsie Ashworth reported multiple errors in the 'Pay to Park' program, including ticketing of vehicles with handicap placards and confusing kiosk instructions. The matter was referred to a Committee of the Whole meeting scheduled for April 22nd.

items.title: Kiosk Operational Hour Restrictions
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting the Consumer Advisory Commission intervene to ensure parking kiosks do not accept payment outside of posted operational hours.

items.title: Recognition of High School Athletics Teams
items.summary: Presented commendations to the Medford High School varsity gymnastics and girls' basketball teams for winning their respective Greater Boston League championships.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Noise Remediation
items.summary: Hospital leadership agreed to fund an independent acoustical engineering study inside a resident's home to identify and mitigate persistent noise originating from the campus. The Council requested a formal report on the study's findings upon completion.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital and Partners Healthcare Merger
items.summary: Approved a motion to send a letter to the Attorney General supporting the hospital's merger with Partners Healthcare, with the condition that hospital licensure be granted immediately upon the effective date. President Alan McDonald detailed the necessity of the merger for long-term clinical and economic sustainability.

items.title: Wendy's Restaurant Outdoor Dining License
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the outdoor dining license for Wendy's at 330 Middlesex Ave, extending patio hours to 10:00 p.m. with a required six-month operational review.

items.title: Reappointments to the Commission of Trust Funds
items.summary: Confirmed the reappointment of Judith Beatrice; the reappointment of James Tarani was tabled until he can appear before the body.

items.title: Tufts University Janitorial Reorganization Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution recommending that Tufts University and its service provider maintain current janitorial staffing levels and avoid planned layoffs of approximately one-third of the workforce. The Council further requested that the University administration provide a formal briefing on the reorganization chart.

items.title: Ceremonial Birthdays and Condolences
items.summary: Approved a birthday resolution for Alfred Valenti and memorial resolutions for Joe Conway, Raymond Marano, and Barbara Belcastro.

items.title: School District Drug Prevention and Education
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive report from the Superintendent on current drug prevention programs and teacher training initiatives. The motion was amended to include a request for the Police Chief to report on the status of reinstating the DARE program in schools.

items.title: West Medford Square Pedestrian Safety
items.summary: Approved a request for the installation of additional crosswalk signs in West Medford Square and directed the Department of Transportation to repair safety stanchions at the railroad crossing.

items.title: Medford Square and Route 16 Lighting Failures
items.summary: Approved a motion on roll call demanding the Mayor immediately address non-functional public safety lighting in Medford Square and the Condon Shell parking lot.

items.title: Republic Parking Contract Compliance
items.summary: Referred a resolution to committee that calls for ticketing and towing of Republic Parking vehicles for alleged contract violations regarding vehicle identification and equipment. Members cited ongoing issues with aggressive enforcement and improper ticketing of residents with valid permits.

items.title: Public Access Television and Cable Contracts
items.summary: Requested an update on the status of the Verizon FIOS and Comcast contracts and a formal accounting of subscriber fees held by the city.

items.title: Tufts University Snow Runoff Review
items.summary: Referred a response from Tufts University regarding snow disposal on athletic fields to the Board of Health to investigate potential environmental contaminants in runoff water.
